newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 695,000 MT were 2 percent below the previous week, but 5 percent above the 4-week average.

Major increases for Germany (181,000 MT, includes 68,100 new sales, 114,900 destination changes), the Netherlands (138,600 MT), Japan (107,600 MT), China (55,000 MT, includes 5,000 new sales, 50,000 destination changes), and Mexico (49,000 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (34,400 MT) and Portugal (22,100 MT).

Exports of 810,900 MT were off 22 percent from the previous week and 12 percent from the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Germany (183,000 MT), the Netherlands (129,600 MT), Mexico (73,400 MT), Malaysia (56,700 MT), and China (55,000 MT).
